usedFor: Easyship knows the shipments and LeadConnector holds the contacts, so “Shipment Delivered” can update a contact there.

bestTemplate.name: “Shipment Delivered” in Easyship, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: The action creates the contact or updates it, so a repeat buyer does not get a second record.

watchOut: Every Easyship trigger here is polling, so “Shipment Delivered” reaches LeadConnector after a short delay.
